title: Label-free LC-MS proteomics of oral squamous cell carcinoma patients and healthy controls: proteomics
projectDescription: This study compared serum proteomic expressions of 41 oral squamous cell carcinoma patients and 44 healthy controls.  The data was acquired with UDMSE in resolution mode and targeted fragmentation with DIA. This project consist of two parallel projects: proteomic and N-glycopeptidomic projects. This is the proteomic project. Due to in-parallel N-glycoproteomic analysis the abundant serum proteins were included in the proteomics.
sampleProcessingProtocol: 41 OSCC serum samples and 44 healthy control serum samples were desalted, albumin depleted and leftover proteins were alkylated, reduced and digested with trypsin. The peptides were separated from N-glycopeptides with size exclusion chromatography (SEC).  125ng of peptide mixture was injected to mass spectrometer and the raw data was collected with UDMSE and data independent acquisition (DIA).
dataProcessingProtocol: The quantitation and identification was performed with Progenesis QIP software and the raw data was mass corrected with lockmass ion leucine enkephalin, aligned and normalized with Hi3 E.Coli internal standard.
